Farage spotted coming out of disguise shop
item.description: Nigel Farage is understood to have bought the entire stock of a London disguise shop for his new MPs. He couldn’t do it online as he doesn’t know how to use computers. That’s what he told the Standards Committee, anyway. ‘He’s bought a blonde wig for Suella’, a spokesman told us. ‘Bold choice. The voters will never remember she used to be a Tory. Robert Jenrick will dress up as the Childcatcher from Chitty Chitty Bang Bang. It’s a despised role, but still better than being Robert Jenrick....

item.title: Regulars at one Oxford JD Weatherspoon demand early breakfasts are banned
item.description: An Oxfordshire JD Weatherspoons is coming under pressure from its early morning customers to ban cooked breakfasts.
